_comment: Shared RA-to-authority exchanges: issuance and revocation at L0 selected from the authority contract's candidate vectors (revision 3), and domain bindings, L1 issuance under a binding and L2 (refused) from a reference model of candidate r4. Synthetic data; every key is a test key derived from a public label. Each vector runs against a fresh authority with its clock fixed at each step's now; dns steps set what the authority's resolver answers from then on; a vector may adjust the domain-binding policy or run without a resolver. A 200 answer with a body is byte-exact under the reference derivation of identifiers; a refusal is compared by status, code, path and whether request_id is echoed. No sentinel may appear in a refusal.
